name: HybridX Race
description: Race and simulation timer for HYROX-format events. One button per split, every run and station recorded as a lap.

configFields.label: Roxzone splits
configFields.description: Record Roxzone in and out as separate laps.

configFields.label: Run distance
configFields.description: How long each run is in a simulation. 1000 m is the race distance.
configFields.validationMessage: Between 100 and 1000 metres, in 100 m steps.

configFields.label: Split lock
configFields.description: Ignore the split button for this many seconds after a split.

configFields.label: Vibrate on split
configFields.description: Vibrate when a new segment starts.

configFields.label: Target finish
configFields.description: Target race time in minutes. 0 turns targets off.
